subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

His presence of mind and _______ saved the life of the elderly woman.
solution:
The correct answer is '**audacity**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word "**audacity**" means boldness or courage. (साहस या निर्भीकता)
 
• His presence of mind and audacity saved the life of the elderly woman.
 
• The other options: "**fear**," "**carelessness**," and "**cowardice**" do not fit the context as appropriately.

​Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 3**'.

**Complete Sentence:** *His presence of mind and audacity__ saved the life of the elderly woman.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Fear (डर)**: means an unpleasant emotion caused by the belief that someone or something is dangerous.
 
• **Carelessness (लापरवाही)**: means lack of attention or caution.
 
• **Cowardice (कायरता)**: means lack of bravery or courage.
